caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, cylindrical glass tumbler centered on a plain, light beige background. The glass is colorless, with subtle blue-grey and white shading used to indicate reflections and the texture of the glass. The tumbler features vertical grooves around its body and a horizontal band encircling it about two-thirds from the base. The rim of the glass is smooth and rounded. There is a faint horizontal line and a small ruler-like scale drawn near the bottom left, and the name "JOHN DANA" is handwritten in small, capital letters at the lower right corner. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Tumbler
